recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-33065 unless a future work-group decision changes the logical-model StructureDefinition.type rule.
issue_request: FHIR-33065 was a Published FHIR-core StructureDefinition change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to clarify that StructureDefinition.type for logical models SHALL be a fully specified URL and that the type name should start with the final path segment of that URL where required.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 6ad3e66b264b665f9b5b20e93f319ecf7ced6e64, which changed the StructureDefinition.type comment from optional-sounding URL wording to SHALL/fully specified URL/final path segment wording. The change was later merged by 1d769fe82f752181812e20765024fa913f1e8e35.
additional_context: StructureDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. The initiating Zulip thread records the ambiguity and Grahame Grieve's answer that absolute URLs are required for non-HL7 logical models, and the FHIR-I 2021-08-30 minutes record the 16-0-1 Persuasive with Modification vote to use fully specified URL wording. FHIR-13331 is historical background because it introduced the earlier logical-model URL wording that FHIR-33065 clarified.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml already says logical-model StructureDefinition.type SHALL be a fully specified URL and includes the final path segment example.
